body.text: You want a friend to do a small thing - buy the tickets, call the plumber back, send the quote - without asking three times in a messenger whether it is done. In Shuuty you give them a task and it lands in their own app. This guide walks the whole way, from the invitation to the finished task, and shows the real app screen at every step.
Invite your friend
You can give a task to someone on your Shuuty friends list. Friends are added with a link or a QR code - there is no search across all users.
On the **Planner** screen tap the person-with-a-plus icon. The **Friends** screen opens with the **Invitation link and QR code** card at the bottom.
body.alt: The Friends screen in Shuuty with the Invitation link and QR code card

body.text: The card shows a QR code and a link. Choose **Send friend request** - when the link is opened, the recipient gets a friend request from you. **Send app link** only leads to installing Shuuty, with no request.
body.alt: Choosing the link type: Send friend request or Send app link

body.text: Your friend accepts
Your friend opens the link (without the app, it leads through the install). A counter appears on their person-with-a-plus icon, and the **Awaiting** tab shows your request with an **Accept** button.
body.alt: The Awaiting tab with Maja's request and an Accept button

body.text: Your friend chooses how tasks arrive
In **Profile**, under **Preferences**, your friend opens **Task from friends** and picks **Right away**, **After approval** (Accept or Reject first) or **Off**. It does not apply to group tasks.
body.alt: The Task from friends sheet with Right away, After approval and Off

body.text: Say or type the task
Tap **+** at the bottom of the screen. **Voice** records the task, **Task** opens a form to type it, where you pick the assignee in **Assign to...**. How long you can record depends on your plan.
In **Voice** say the task the way you would say it to your friend, for example "Ask Alex to send the proposal to the client tomorrow at 9 AM".
body.alt: Recording a task by voice in Shuuty

body.text: Shuuty turns the recording into a task: title, assignee, due date, reminder and place. You can correct every field and change the assignee in **Assign to...** - the list shows your friends. Then tap **Send**.
body.alt: A task prepared from the recording: title, assignee Alex, due date, reminder and place

body.text: Your friend gets the task

Your friend gets a notification that they received a new task from you and finds it in **Received**, with who it is from. With **After approval** they first decide whether to take it, and you get a notification when they accept or reject it.
body.alt: The Received tab with a task from Maja

body.text: Follow the task and talk about it
Everything you handed out is in **Delegated**. When your friend marks the task complete, a green check appears next to their name. In the task details you can talk in the task's own discussion.
body.alt: A delegated task in Shuuty with its details

body.text: What Shuuty does not do here

items: **It will not give a task to someone who is not on your friends list.** The invitation comes first. Group tasks work differently: they go to the group's members.
**It will not assign a task when your friend chose Off.** Then friends cannot assign tasks to them.
**It does not send a notification when the task is done.** You see it in Delegated by the green check next to the assignee.
**It does not run in a browser.** Both of you need the app on iPhone, iPad or Android.

body.text: What it costs

Starting is free: the core features with limits, such as how long a voice recording can be. The Pro and Teams plans raise the limits. Prices depend on the country and are shown in the App Store and Google Play.

faq.question: Does my friend need Shuuty?
faq.answer: Yes. The invitation link opens the app or leads through installing it. Shuuty has no web version.

faq.question: Can I give my friend a task without their consent?
faq.answer: It depends on their Task from friends setting: with Right away the task reaches them at once, with After approval they accept or reject it first, and with Off you cannot assign them a task.

faq.question: Do I have to record the task by voice?
faq.answer: No. You can also type it in a form: tap +, then Task.

faq.question: Does this setting apply to group tasks too?
faq.answer: No. Task from friends covers only tasks from people on your friends list, outside groups.
